## Preparation

```{r}
library(haven)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
source(here("src", "R_params.R"))
check_paths()

# The two map chunks under "Data coverage" are optional; they need rnaturalearth, which is not in
# environment.yml. Set to TRUE after install.packages(c("rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata")).
DRAW_MAPS <- FALSE

# CONVENTIONS.md §1: data/raw is immutable. This file used to write its inputs back over
# themselves, which silently re-based every downstream model. Outputs are date-stamped (§3)
# unless this is flipped deliberately.
OVERWRITE_SHIPPED <- FALSE
out_path <- function(name) {
  if (OVERWRITE_SHIPPED) file.path(RAW, paste0(name, ".csv")) else stamped(name)
}

full_groundtruth <- read_csv(file.path(RAW, "groundtruth_offline_predictors_pop.csv"),
                             show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Filtering

```{r}
internet_indicator <- full_groundtruth %>%
  select(country.x, survey_start, survey_type, iso3, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom, perc_used_internet_past12months_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wom, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men) & is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_men)))

internet_indicator <- internet_indicator %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio = ifelse(survey_type == "itu", perc_used_internet_past12months_wom/perc_used_internet_past12months_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio))

##priority list: pick the most recent dhs and mics, if no, choose itu, but the survey starting year should be later than 2014
internet_indicator <- internet_indicator %>%
  group_by(iso3) %>%
  filter(survey_start == min(survey_start)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(survey_start > 2013)


internet_indicator_without_itu <- internet_indicator %>%
  filter(survey_type != "itu")

##noticing that we don't have fm ratio for itu data, let's add them back

full_groundtruth <- full_groundtruth %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio = ifelse(survey_type == "itu", perc_used_internet_past12months_wom/perc_used_internet_past12months_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio))

write_csv(full_groundtruth, out_path("groundtruth_offline_predictors_pop"))
```

## Data coverage

```{r, eval = DRAW_MAPS}
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
world_map <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

world_map_with_internet <- world_map %>%
  left_join(internet_indicator, by = c("iso_a3" = "iso3")) %>%
  mutate(internet_ratio_without_itu = ifelse(survey_type == "itu", NA, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio))

ggplot(data = world_map_with_internet) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio), 
          data = world_map_with_internet[world_map_with_internet$iso_a3 != "ATA", ]) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Female:Male Internet Usage Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Data Coverage of Internet Indicators"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )


ggplot(data = world_map_with_internet) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = internet_ratio_without_itu), 
          data = world_map_with_internet[world_map_with_internet$iso_a3 != "ATA", ]) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Female:Male Internet Usage Ratio") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Data Coverage of Internet Indicators (Without ITU)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )
```

## Output

```{r}
write_csv(internet_indicator, out_path("internet_indicator"))
```

## no filter

```{r}
full_groundtruth <- read_csv(file.path(RAW, "groundtruth_offline_predictors.csv"),
                             show_col_types = FALSE)

internet_indicator <- full_groundtruth %>%
  select(country.x, survey_start, survey_type, iso3, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom, perc_used_internet_past12months_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wom, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men) & is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_men)))

internet_indicator <- internet_indicator %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio = ifelse(survey_type == "itu", perc_used_internet_past12months_wom/perc_used_internet_past12months_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio))

internet_indicator <- internet_indicator %>%
  arrange(country.x, survey_start) %>%
  group_by(country.x, survey_start) %>%
  mutate(n = n())

internet_indicator <- internet_indicator %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_men = ifelse(n == 2 & is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_men), lead(perc_used_internet_past12months_men),perc_used_internet_past12months_men),
         perc_used_internet_past12months_wom = ifelse(n == 2 & is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_wom), lead(perc_used_internet_past12months_wom), perc_used_internet_past12months_wom)) %>%
  filter(n != 2 | survey_type != "itu") %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_men = ifelse(n == 2,(perc_used_internet_past12months_men + perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men)/2, perc_used_internet_past12months_men),
         perc_used_internet_past12months_wom = ifelse(n == 2, (perc_used_internet_past12months_wom + perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom)/2, perc_used_internet_past12months_wom)) %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_men = ifelse(is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_men), perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_men),
         perc_used_internet_past12months_wom = ifelse(is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_wom), perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom, perc_used_internet_past12months_wom)) %>%
  select(-perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men, -perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom, -n) %>%
  mutate(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_fm_perc_ratio = perc_used_internet_past12months_wom/perc_used_internet_past12months_men) %>%
  mutate(survey_type = ifelse(iso3 == "CUB", "mics6+itu", survey_type)) %>%
  mutate(survey_type = ifelse(iso3 == "ZMB", "dhs7+itu", survey_type))

write_csv(internet_indicator, out_path("internet_indicator_multipule_years"))
```

## clean dataset for Casey

```{r}
full_groundtruth_out <- full_groundtruth %>%
  select(1:48) %>%
  filter(survey_type != "gsma") %>%
  select(-contains("pop"), -contains("past3months")) %>%
  mutate(internet_use_in_12_months_men = ifelse(is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men), perc_used_internet_past12months_men, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_men),
         internet_use_in_12_months_wom = ifelse(is.na(perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom), perc_used_internet_past12months_wom, perc_used_internet_past12months_wght_age_15_to_49_wom),
         owns_mobile_phone_men = ifelse(is.na(perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_age_15_to_49_men), perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_men, perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_age_15_to_49_men),
         owns_mobile_phone_wom = ifelse(is.na(perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_age_15_to_49_wom), perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_wom, perc_owns_mobile_telephone_wght_age_15_to_49_wom)) %>%
  select(c(2:6), 10, 14, 16, c(36:40)) %>%
  mutate(used_internet_past12months_fm_perc_ratio = internet_use_in_12_months_wom/internet_use_in_12_months_men,
         owns_mobile_phone_fm_perc_ratio = owns_mobile_phone_wom/owns_mobile_phone_men)


write_csv(full_groundtruth_out, out_path("internet_mobile_indicator_clean"))
```
